title: Shibby Empire Teaser Announcement (ORIGINAL)
description: Me and some friends have been working behind the scenes for a while on a very special project, and I am finally ready to share some teaser details about what you have to expect... Many of my favorite files are often my most ambitious, featuring sprawling stories with multiple characters where you can get completely lost in the world I’ve created. Up until now though I’ve used things like audio editing and my best acting ability to inhabit different characters and personas. Don’t get me wrong, that’s not going to stop, but I think it would be fun to work with other Dommes, having them play those roles while I can be the one pulling the strings always front and center. I also happen to have some friends interested in this lifestyle. So… I am so pleased to introduce to you my two friends who are going to be officially joining me and start building a Shibby Empire of creators! Plus, I do really *really* like the idea of having my own Empire of gorgeous girls at my side doing my bidding for me. The cult files are going to be SO GOOD! Meet Monika: Monika is a natural redhead high protocol dominant, oozing confidence and charisma. She has been involved in the kinky scene for many years with experience as a professional dominatrix and running events. A genuine lover of all things kinky, latex, leather, feet, smoking, you name it. For the last few months Monika has dived feet first into content creation consistently making high quality audios specializing in D/s hypnosis, mantras, fetishes and her original female supremacy novella audiobook series Il Castello de Diabella. Audios are just the tip of the iceberg though, like all my friends she is a geek at heart too and you can find photoshoots, cosplays and slave tasks for her indoctrinated followers to perform on Patreon. Consider supporting her on Patreon if you can or checking out her fledgling subreddit to find out more like her first cosplay themed free audio “Jessie Catches You in the Long Grass”. Meet Embrr: Embrr meanwhile has a deliciously soft sultry voice. A tattoo artist by trade and alternate lifestyle enthusiast. If you ever feel like you just want to escape for a while from the chaos and stress of the world around you then look no further. Embrr wants to embrace fantasy and the fantastical in a safe and consensual setting that is inclusive for everyone at all times. They'll whisk you away using their skill with tattoos to help relieve the pressure of existing, relaxing your brain and giving you a physical reminder you can come back to when you need relief with a simple touch. They are in the process of learning about audios as they go and can't wait to see what things evolve into over time. Once they are ready, they'll also have a Patreon of their own for you to support and all the usual stuff you might expect. This week our first collaboration audio is hitting Patreon "Three Girls One Key”. A playful companion file for the start of Locktober where we each try and convince you to lock yourself in chastity and give us the key. Embrr will talk you out of it and show you kindness. Monika will keep you locked up just to laugh at you. I will use every trick in the book just because I hate losing. Who are you gunna choose to have the key? This is only just the beginning of what I have planned. You can expect plenty more collaboration audios between the three of us. Soon I’ll be opening up personalization requests on a new file where you’ll be able to have all three of us whispering your name as we sink you into trance and play with you. I haven't taken this decision lightly. I wanted to bring under my wing good people I trust completely who share the same set of ethics, moral code and high standards that I do. Hypnosis should always be handled with care and the responsibility it deserves and I'm relishing the opportunity to guide the girls in how to do it right from first hand experience. An added benefit of doing this is that they'll be using the same triggers I've spent so long installing too, so it should be fun to see how everyone responds to them when heard slightly differently. I wonder if the effect might be even more powerful with practice. I am going to keep a lot of my cards close to my chest for the bigger plans for what I have in mind, but safe to say just like anything I do they’re grand and ambitious. Who knows, maybe they’ll be fully integrated into Shibbydex in the not too distant future too… Please join me in welcoming them both with open arms into the community and I can’t wait for you all to hear what delightful things we have in store for you.
